constrains.note: subject-level plasma TMAO, micromolar; directly comparable to the model's C_ss output
plasma TMA/(TMA+TMAO) share is a cross-sectional steady-state ratio, not a hepatic flux split; bounds f_fmo3 only if TMA and TMAO share one steady state and TMAO has no other sink
no portal sampling in this study

observational cohort, no isotope tracer and no diet record, so the two factors of the product cannot be separated (the G3 non-identifiability in inputs/Q012_RESULTS.md is NOT resolved by this dataset)
plasma carnitine/choline are endogenous pools, not the ingested dose; the food-level intake the parameter represents is not in this dataset
no antibiotic arm in this study
